analyst.summary: Asahi India Glass is India's dominant auto and architectural glass company, benefiting from rising glass content per vehicle (sunroofs, ADAS-integrated windshields) and a construction upcycle in architectural glass, with margins visibly recovering through the year. However, the stock trades at a rich ~65x earnings against modest returns on capital (~11-14% ROE) and negative free cash flow as the company continues to invest heavily in capacity. We rate this a Hold: real structural tailwinds, but the valuation already prices in a re-rating that the return metrics have not yet delivered.
